description: Top-level domains: every label in IANA's root, with type, registry, RDAP server and each registrar's one-year register/renew/transfer price (Porkbun, Dynadot, Cloudflare, OVHcloud). Sorted by renewal by default, because the first year is a promotion. `best` is the cheapest USD price across registrars; with `registrar` it is that registrar's own price in its currency. Answers carry facet counts. `trap: true` keeps only labels that renew at 2x the first year or more.

idn.description: true: internationalised labels only; false: ASCII only

limit.description: Rows to return, integer 1-500, default 50, e.g. 100

manager.description: Exact registry name, as IANA writes it (optional)

offset.description: Rows to skip for paging, integer, default 0, e.g. 50

order.description: Sort direction: asc or desc, e.g. desc

q.description: Text in the label, its Unicode form or the registry name (optional)

registrar.description: porkbun, dynadot, cloudflare, ovh (optional): only labels it sells, at its prices

sort.description: renew (default), register, transfer, restore, ratio, tld, registrars, type, manager, first_seen

status.description: delegated (default), removed, or all, e.g. removed

trap.description: Only labels renewing at 2x the first year or more

type.description: generic, country-code, sponsored, generic-restricted, infrastructure, test; comma separated (optional)

name: search_tlds
